title: 6 Day Hybrid Athlete
author: Dave F
desc: 11 weeks: right knee scope (Fri 10/30) to the Disney 10K (Fri 1/8). Rules: (1) One day at a time, in order. Miss a day, do the next one tomorrow. (2) AM Knee Check every morning decides the day (GREEN / YELLOW / RED). (3) Gates are hard stops: don't start Week 4 without Gate 1, don't run without Gate 2. (4) Dr. Kissin's instructions override anything here. (5) From Wk 4 the week is: Mon Legs 1, Tue Upper, Wed Z5, Thu Z2/Galloway, Fri Legs 2 + Upper, Sat Z2 flush, Sun rest. (6) Z5 is never skipped: if legs burn, scale watts or intervals instead. Phases: Wk 1 pre-op + surgery | Wk 2-3 home program, motion, left-leg cross-ed | Wk 4-5 quad reload | Wk 6-7 first runs + peak strength | Wk 8-10 run volume, lifting to maintenance | Wk 11 race week.

ex.note: Norwegian 4x4. 10 min warm-up, then 4 x 4 min @ 218-225 W, seated 85-95 rpm, 3 min easy (~100 W) between. 5 min cool-down. 1 set = 1 interval. Chase HR, not watts: HR should reach 155+ by minute 3; if it doesn't, add 5 W next time. LEGS BURNING? Don't skip, scale it: drop one interval and hold the highest watts you can with HR still reaching 155+. Only if HR can't reach ~150 at any watts you can hold, finish as Zone 2. Never make up a missed Z5 later.

Cable pushdown or band. Pull handle down until elbows are pinned at ribs and bent at exactly 90 degrees (forearms parallel to floor). Hold this static 90-degree position completely motionless for the entire 45-second duration. Loads triceps tendon isometrically to desensitize pain and build tendon stiffness.

ss.note: Stop descent when elbows reach ~90 deg bend (protects right triceps tendon insertion; avoids extreme stretch under load).
Pull bar to upper abdomen, stopping elbow pull at ~90 deg bend to manage right triceps tendon stress. Squeeze lats and mid-back.

Seated Dumbbell OHP. Stop descent when upper arms reach parallel (~90 deg elbow bend). Same dumbbells. Right arm sets the reps. After the right stops, left does 2-3 extra reps so it isn't stopping far short of failure.
Pull bar smoothly to upper chest/chin level, stopping elbow bend at ~90 deg. Control the eccentric return.

Ice/cold therapy ready. Towel roll for heel prop (never a pillow under the knee). Crutches available. Prescriptions filled. Ride home arranged. Couch/bed set up. Follow pre-op fasting and skin-prep instructions.

PRE-OP REHEARSAL: Spread through the day (e.g. 10 reps every 1-2 hrs while resting). Lie flat on back, leg straight, small towel roll under ankle so knee is unsupported. Drive the back of your knee firmly DOWN flat into the bed while pulling your kneecap up toward your hip. Squeeze quad at 100% effort for a 5s hold, relax 2s. Focus on firing the inner quad (VMO). 10 reps.

PRE-OP REHEARSAL: 1 set = 1 session. Lock the knee 100% straight with a quad set BEFORE lifting. If the knee sags/bends as you lift (quad lag), stop and do quad sets instead. 1. Supine (on back): Lift locked leg 8-12 inches off bed, pause 1s, lower slowly (10 reps). 2. Side-Lying (on left side): Lift right leg 8-12 inches toward ceiling, lower slowly (10 reps). 3. Prone (face down): Squeeze glute, lift straight leg 4-6 inches, lower slowly (10 reps).

PRE-OP REHEARSAL: 1 set = 1 session. Lie on back or sit upright with legs extended (wear a sock or towel under heel to slide smoothly). Slowly slide right heel toward butt, bending knee until a gentle, comfortable stretch across front (stop before sharp pain). Pause and hold at end-range for 3-5 seconds, then slowly slide back to completely straight. 10-15 controlled reps.

Right knee arthroscopy with Dr. Kissin at Hackensack UMC. Focus: debridement / partial meniscectomy. Discharge checklist: (1) Confirm weight-bearing status (standard: weight-bearing as tolerated with crutches). (2) Confirm dressing removal / shower timeline (typically 48 hrs post-op). (3) Confirm post-op follow-up appointment (POD 7-10). Once home: elevate heel above heart, apply cold therapy 20 min on, and begin gentle ankle pumps.

1 set = 1 session (hourly is great too). Lie flat or recline with leg elevated. Pull foot and toes hard UP toward your shin (dorsiflexion), hold 1s, then point toes hard DOWN away from you like stepping on a gas pedal (plantarflexion), hold 1s. 20 rhythmic reps. Engages calf venous pump to flush swelling out of the lower leg.

1 set = 1 session. Lie down and elevate right heel ABOVE heart level on pillows (support under calf and heel, NEVER place a pillow directly behind the knee). Place ice pack or cold therapy wrap over knee for 20 minutes. Constricts blood vessels, flushes inflammation, and numbs postoperative pain.

First thing upon waking. Look at and bend right knee. GREEN = bends freely, back of knee flat to bed, no puffiness above kneecap: execute day as written. YELLOW = stiff, tight, or 'full' feeling >15 min: do day, but cap weight, NO load progression, NO impact. RED = visible swelling, warmth, or limp: home PT + ice only, no leg loading or cardio.
